verdicts.reason: A keeps the right reading order (presenter, headline, subtitle, date) and nothing collides, but the text has been pulled out of the white card. That leaves an empty white box with two orphaned pink dots in the middle of the pattern, which looks like a missing placeholder, and the subtitle and date float in a lot of blank white space. B is worse: 'The Minimalist' is moved to the top-left, above the headline. 'DDG Studio Presents' now sits below 'Dean Cooper', and the pink dots crash into the D and R. The date line is jammed against the left edge and over the white frame, the frame spills into empty white below, and the bottom third of the canvas is dead space.
